notes: Ganymede runes (CEO: "where are all the runes we have? I need everything so I can define the defaults"): any card can show any shared rune: Calendar, Media player, FPS, Laptop, Volume, Brightness, Microphone, Radios, Power plan, Power…

Battery is its own card (CEO: "on the battery card you have 0.0MB/s why? these need to make sense"): charge, plugged in or not, charge rate, voltage, wear and capacity; Network is network only (download, upload, address). A laptop’s third…

Every reading the PC reports: the CPU card adds hottest and busiest core; the GPU card memory clock, SoC temperature and voltage, fan %, VRAM in GB and power of its limit; Storage adds read and write speed, activity and totals; the sensor…

Editor (CEO: "this all looks really smashed together"): Customize’s panels get one rhythm: more room round each row, the hint under its label, more space above each heading, and an open layer and its settings drawn as one block.
